lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of roughly parallel horizontal rows composed of discrete, high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the pectoral fin attachment. The spots are arranged in at least four distinct longitudinal lines.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Multiple vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the longitudinal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient (light above, shadow below) runs horizontally along the upper third of the flank, extending from the posterior branchial region toward the caudal area.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits an irregular distribution of high-luminance blobs, with approximately 8-10 distinct spots visible within its silhouette, primarily located in the anterior and basal sections.
